title: KIA Seizes Two Junta Outposts in Kachin State — 20+ Killed
detail: The Kachin Independence Army (KIA) seized two military outposts in Khaunglanhpu (Putao District) and around Shwegu Township, Kachin State, between July 10-12, 2026, capturing approximately 20 firearms along with ammunition and supplies, and taking militia prisoners. More than 20 junta soldiers and allied militia were reportedly killed in the operations. Fighting continued in Shwegu as junta reinforcements moved to the area.

media.caption: KIA seizes two junta outposts in Kachin State's Khaunglanhpu and Shwegu areas.

title: Burmese Women's Union: 332 Women Killed by Junta Violence in First Half of 2026
detail: The Burmese Women's Union released a report on July 13, 2026 documenting 332 women killed and 306 injured by junta violence between January and June 2026 across Myanmar, including 58 girls under 18 and 10 pregnant women. Deaths resulted primarily from airstrikes, artillery shelling, landmines, arson, and sexual violence. The highest tolls were recorded in Sagaing Region (102), Bago Region (47), Rakhine State (41), Karen State (17), and Tanintharyi Region (15), reflecting the geographic spread of the junta's aerial and ground campaigns against resistance-held areas.

media.caption: Burmese Women's Union report: 332 women killed by junta violence, January-June 2026.
